## Standards

- **Must — Launcher launders distinct failures into `spawn-failed`.** `bin/ak-docket-record.js:18-27,39-53` emits the same `spawn-failed` object with `diagnostic: null` both when the packaged entry is unreadable and when spawning fails. The first case is not a spawn failure, and neither preserves safe cause evidence. Violates `CLAUDE.md`’s “未识别异常不得冒用具体标签；真因必须落痕”.

- **Must — Destination probing converts unknown filesystem failures into occupancy.** `src/recorder/run.ts:145-159` treats every `lstatSync` failure except `ENOENT` as “occupied”; callers consequently report `destination-exists` without a diagnostic. Permission, platform, or unexpected errors therefore borrow a false specific label. Same failure-honesty rule.

- **Must — Containment checks catch and continue after losing filesystem truth.** `src/recorder/paths.ts:191-247` suppresses non-`RecorderError` failures from `lstatSync`/`realpathSync`, then may return successfully after checking only a parent. `src/recorder/paths.ts:261-268` similarly substitutes lexical `resolve()` when realpath fails and can declare scratch “outside.” Violates “catch 后照常继续视同缺陷，除非「此失败下继续」是文档化契约” and “真因必须落痕”.

- **Must — Admission’s committed-file check is catch-all permissive.** `src/recorder/admit.ts:220-237` maps every failure from either Git command—including missing Git, permission failures, and unexpected subprocess errors—to `false`, allowing admission to continue. Only expected “not a repository/not tracked” outcomes are lawful negatives. Same catch-and-continue rule.

## Spec

- **Must — Failure honesty remains incomplete across caught owners.** Authority requires that wrapping retain the underlying cause and specific codes be used only when proved (`.ak/dockets/issues/23/authority/judge-001/receipt.json`, governing contract 1–2). Arbitrary destination `lstatSync` errors become cause-less `destination-exists` (`src/recorder/run.ts:145-160,287-293`); collision catches discard the rename cause (`run.ts:195-205`); containment errors are swallowed (`src/recorder/paths.ts:191-247`); Git failures become “not committed” (`src/recorder/admit.ts:220-237`); and launcher catches emit `spawn-failed`/`diagnostic:null` (`bin/ak-docket-record.js:39-54`).

- **Must — A pure environment defect survives until spawn and is misclassified.** Authority requires every structurally decidable lexical defect before scanner/filesystem/Git/admission/spawn. The parser accepts NUL-containing environment names/values (`src/recorder/config.ts:285-326`), forwards them (`config.ts:482-489`), and `src/recorder/spawn.ts:54-64` reports Node’s synchronous rejection as late `spawn-failed`, not located `invalid-config`. An isolated no-artifact probe confirmed the Node rejection.

- **Must — The shipped failure schema is not closed as ordered.** Review-001 requires closed location segments and child signal combinations plus fixed messages (`.ak/dockets/issues/23/judgment/review-001/receipt.json`, disposition 3). `schemas/recorder-failure-v1.schema.json:43-64,213-216` permits any bounded message, arbitrary string location segments/unbounded path length, and arbitrary signal strings, broader than the fixed runtime messages and finite production vocabulary.

The target explicitly leaves the historical swallowed exception, original invocation, Recorder-entry timing, and ~920-second cause indeterminate; this review makes no root-cause claim. No issue-#13 behavior or retained-snapshot-policy violation was found.

Verification: focused Recorder tests passed 50/50; typecheck and `build:recorder` passed with no source/generated diff.

Summary: Standards 4 findings (worst: containment continues without filesystem truth); Spec 3 findings (worst: caught owners still misclassify or erase causes).
